**Bug Description**
Describe the issue you're having here.

**Latest log (+crash report if any)**
Upload the latest.log to https://mclo.gs and paste the link here. If the issue is a crash, also upload the crash report to the same site. DO NOT paste the logs directly into this box! It makes the issue very hard to read.

**Mod List**
Put a list of mods here, along with their versions. This will help root out incompatibilities.
Example:
TACZ Turrets 1.1.0
TACZ 1.1.7-hotfix2
Embeddium 0.3.31

**Extra Info**
Put anything else in this box that doesn't fit in the other categories.
